EmailTemplate.name: Sales Order Reminder Pattern A: Recipient
EmailTemplate.subject: Reminder 1 – PDC Outstanding {!SalesOrder__c.Name}
EmailTemplate.textOnly: Dear {!SalesOrder__c.OwnerFullName}, Kindly note that the Post-Dated Cheques (PDCs) relating to {!SalesOrder__c.Name}, created on {!SalesOrder__c.CreatedDate} for {!SalesOrder__c.CustomerAccount__c}, remain outstanding. As part of the standard sales process and in accordance with the agreed payment terms, the required PDCs must be collected and submitted to enable the transaction to progress in line with the customer's payment schedule. Please arrange for the collection and submission of the outstanding PDCs no later than [Due Date] and provide an update once they have been received. Your prompt attention to this matter is appreciated. Thank you.
